name: Consent
verbatim_definition: Refers to a freely given, specific, informed, and unambiguous indication, whether by a statement or clear affirmative action, signifying agreement to the processing of personal data by a data subject.
comparative_note: the Authority declared that consent is not the primary basis for processing personal data in the KVKK; rather, it is one of several legal bases, aligning with the GDPR.
source_document: KB 2/Turkey/Kişisel Verilerin Korunması Kanunu (Turkish Personal Data Protection Law - KVKK).pdf

name: Performance of a contract, taking necessary steps to enter into a contract at the request of a data subject
verbatim_definition: Refers to a situation processing personal data should be required for the execution of a contractual agreement or establishment of a contract with the data subject.
comparative_note: the KVKK uses the term "directly related to the establishment or performance of the contract" while explaining this basis under Article 5(2)(c).
source_document: KB 2/Turkey/Kişisel Verilerin Korunması Kanunu (Turkish Personal Data Protection Law - KVKK).pdf

name: Legal obligation
verbatim_definition: Refers to a legal obligation to be needed fulfill.
comparative_note: Under the KVKK as well, a “legal obligation” generally refers to a controller's legal obligation arising from law. (Bilir, 2020, p.325) However, this legal ground also covers contractual obligations too.
source_document: KB 2/Turkey/Kişisel Verilerin Korunması Kanunu (Turkish Personal Data Protection Law - KVKK).pdf

name: Vital interest
verbatim_definition: Refers to a situation that processing personal data is necessary to protect vital interest of data subjects or others like right to live.
comparative_note: KVKK's vital interest is applicable only when consent is not feasible.
source_document: KB 2/Turkey/Kişisel Verilerin Korunması Kanunu (Turkish Personal Data Protection Law - KVKK).pdf

name: Legitimate interest
verbatim_definition: refers to situation that a current and present benefit which is conformable with laws stands for that specific processing.
comparative_note: conducting a balance test is required since under both regulations processing is allowed by relying on this legal basis if the interests or fundamental rights and freedoms of the data subjects are not overridden.
source_document: KB 2/Turkey/Kişisel Verilerin Korunması Kanunu (Turkish Personal Data Protection Law - KVKK).pdf

name: Performance of a public interest task or the exercise of official authority
source_document: KB 2/Turkey/Kişisel Verilerin Korunması Kanunu (Turkish Personal Data Protection Law - KVKK).pdf

name: Expressly provided for by the law
comparative_note: Missing in the GDPR. Even though it appears to be an additional basis in the KVKK, not included in the GDPR, this basis aligns with the concepts of "legal obligation" and/or "public interest" under the GDPR.
source_document: KB 2/Turkey/Kişisel Verilerin Korunması Kanunu (Turkish Personal Data Protection Law - KVKK).pdf

name: Personal data have been made public by the data subject
comparative_note: Missing in the GDPR. The Authority emphasizes a narrow interpretation of personal data that has been publicly made available.
source_document: KB 2/Turkey/Kişisel Verilerin Korunması Kanunu (Turkish Personal Data Protection Law - KVKK).pdf

name: Data processing is necessary for the establishment, exercise or protection of any right
comparative_note: Missing in the GDPR. (Cited in the source as "Art. 5(1)(e) of the KVKK".) This legal basis under the KVKK provides an opportunity for processing when there is a right stemming from legal, administrative, or any related grounds.
source_document: KB 2/Turkey/Kişisel Verilerin Korunması Kanunu (Turkish Personal Data Protection Law - KVKK).pdf
